authenticity_review: The image exhibits high technical quality in lighting and composition but suffers from specific AI artifacts. The 'sparkling' texture on the horses appears as a uniform digital overlay rather than physical material interaction with light (texture anomaly). The structural plausibility of the roof rack supporting two full-sized horses is questionable, appearing somewhat flimsy. However, the birds and truck are rendered with good realism. The primary failure is semantic/spatial (truck not on birds) rather than visual artifact severity.

Texture artifact: Horse sparkle looks like a flat digital filter ignoring muscle definition and lighting physics.
